limitations: Stagewise greedy versus joint optimum changes future-contract information as well as decision rule; no causal attribution of entire gap to algorithm or lookahead.
Historical comparator shares a stagewise information restriction but is an archived exact local-selection policy, not a greedy baseline.
Route cost sums describe independent executions, not one shared acquisition experiment.
Kernel is finite and deterministic, not an observational sample and not external validation.
Timing is one descriptive run with disclosed stage caching, not a hardware-controlled speed benchmark.
No graph-wide policy optimum, noisy decoder, physical error independence, authority or receipt-chain claim.

policy.available_information: Inherited typed coordinates, finite response kernel, current destination target/sensor/distance only. Subsequent destination and optimal/historical witness are not passed to stage policy.
policy.demand: Each coordinate reduces each positive pair deficit by at most one; gain counts pair constraints with positive residual demand, not the sum of residual distances attached to a query.
policy.modifications_after_results: No tie-rule tuning or policy selection is authorized under this protocol.
policy.objective: At each stage, repeatedly maximize the number of currently unsatisfied relevant pair constraints separated by one new coordinate, divided by unit acquisition cost.
policy.stage_two: Continue from full stage-one evidence; use only final destination sensor.
policy.stop: Immediately once current destination contract is met; acquire nothing if already met.
policy.tie_break: Ascending numerical mask (equivalently fixed-width 3-digit hex lexical order) among maximum positive gains.
policy.uniqueness: Exclude every inherited or already acquired typed coordinate. Same mask under another sensor remains a different coordinate.

scope: All 46 archived routes; actual archived finite deterministic ECH kernel. No synthetic observations or instance generation.
scope_checks: All chosen coordinates satisfy sensor, domain and uniqueness
Replay exact greedy maximizer and first-mask tie at every step
Check recorded optimum via archived rational dual over every original coordinate and matching integer witness
Validate first-stage certified local minimum comparison
Retain every route and sensor-pair jurisdiction including ties and losses
